stem: A suspected contagious disease has high propagation-source consequences but uncertain visual evidence. What is the strongest action?
choices: Make a definitive visual diagnosis and release unaffected-looking material.
Preserve containment and escalate for stronger qualified confirmation proportional to the consequence of being wrong.
Ignore the finding until symptoms become severe.
rationale: Preserve containment and escalate for stronger qualified confirmation proportional to the consequence of being wrong.
